environment.evidenceBoundary: Reproduces the bypass and its repair by driving the real CLI. Before: two commands took an agent from nothing to canonical human-reviewed history, proven end to end in a throwaway repository. After: 11 adversarial cases refused or promoted correctly (assert a reviewer, assert a status, no approval, hand-stamped record, replayed nonce, draft edited after approval, expired approval, wrong event), plus 14 unit tests. Boundary: three commands of roughly seventy were driven. No claim is made about Atlas, frontend, harness, models, skills or routing.
